envelope.description: Retry-now: worker action, host handling and the retrying row in the webview

body.title: Retry-now: worker action, host handling and the retrying row in the webview
body.summary: Add 'retry-now' to the worker's act (retryNow then an immediate tick; refused with a note on any other row); handle outbox-retry-now in the chat host's outbox action switch beside cancel, dismiss and resend; in the webview script draw, for a retrying row, 'attempt n of 3', a countdown to nextAttemptAt that ticks, a retry-now button and the existing cancel button; the chat-outbox projection already carries attempt and nextAttemptAt. This task also carries the worker-level test of the whole retry progression against the real store (a retrying head is held until due, then runs; three failed retries end failed and the next message runs), so it is not lost.
acceptanceChecks: act retry-now on a retrying row runs it at the next tick; on any other row it is refused with a note
outbox-retry-now from the webview reaches the worker with its seq and re-posts the outbox with any refusal note
a retrying row shows 'attempt n of 3', a countdown, a retry-now button and a cancel button, and cancel still removes it
a worker holds a retrying head until due and then runs it; three failed retries end failed and the next message runs

tests.name: chat-queue-worker.test.ts: a retrying head is not taken before its due time, holds the queue behind it, and runs when due
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: a message that fails three infrastructure retries ends failed and the next message runs
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: act retry-now on a retrying row runs it at the next tick; on any other row it is refused with a note
chat-outbox.test.ts: a retrying row carries attempt and nextAttemptAt
chat-shell.test.ts: a retrying row shows 'attempt n of 3', a countdown, a retry-now button and a cancel button, and retry-now posts outbox-retry-now with its seq
